spot.html_text: The study of Aristotle through close textual reading of his works continued, if not increased, in Late Antiquity. So did the supply of commentaries on all his major works. Unlike Alexander of Aphrodisias, most of these commentators considered themselves followers of Plato (that is, Platonists.) By their lights, Plato’s philosophy was superior to all the systems of thought that came later.
